subject: Energy
title: Energy and Quality of Life
description: One-minute skill: Energy and Quality of Life.

hook.text: Access to energy transforms quality of life—lighting enables education, refrigeration preserves food and medicine.

buildup.text: The Human Development Index rises steeply with energy use—up to about 100 GJ per person per year, then it flattens.

discovery.text: Beyond a threshold, more energy doesn't improve wellbeing—the US uses twice the energy per capita of Europe.

twist.text: Efficiency means comfort costs less energy—a well-insulated home needs a fraction of the heating energy of a drafty one.

climax.text: The goal is 'sufficiency'—providing good lives for all without the wasteful overconsumption of energy-rich nations.

punchline.text: Enough energy for good lives—not more energy for waste.

quiz.question: What happens to wellbeing beyond a certain energy threshold?
options: It flattens—more energy doesn't help much
